response.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) as average_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) as number_of_telescopes FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct >= 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus ORDER BY calibrstatus;

assumptions.assumption: "Using 47.6 as the cutoff" means bandusagepct >= 47.6 (values at or above the threshold are considered high). An alternative is > 47.6 (strictly above).

alternatives.interpretation: If "high bandwidth usage" means strictly greater than the cutoff (excluding 47.6 exactly)
alternatives.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) as average_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) as number_of_telescopes FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus ORDER BY calibrstatus;
